$comment: Copy the keys you need into .devbook/config.json. Every key is optional; an absent key takes the engine's documented default. `id` names the repository — lowercase, digits, hyphens — and is what a machine keys its own overlay for this repository on; pick it once and never rename it. Roles and services start unbound: fill each with a provider id — `plugin:skill`, a bare `plugin` resolved through its role, or `repo:<skill>` — naming whichever specialist plugin you installed. A service that takes options is an object instead, e.g. { "provider": "…", "host": "aspire" }. A spec provider may return a specification already approved elsewhere; the run then uses it as returned and derives none inline. delivery.tracker takes github, jira, markdown, or backlog, or a plugin:skill that implements read_item, update_item, and comment. delivery.surface lists the surface servers a run uses — every listed one that opens records the run, and render and export take the first that answers; only a server named delivery-surface-* is a surface — and is usually set per machine in an overlay; absent, every installed surface records the run and render and export go alphabetical by server name. delivery.mcp binds MCP servers per extension point by the id your own MCP configuration declares; a point left out takes the engine default, and mcp-template.json / mcp-vscode-template.json beside this file declare those default servers for .mcp.json and .vscode/mcp.json. Validate with tools/stack-config/check.mjs. The contract is resources/engine-contract.md. Never put a model or a secret in this file.
